title: How To Avoid Rebound Weight Gain
hook: Here's how to come off Zepbound without gaining the fat back.
body:
I have watched multiple people lose a huge amount of fat on Zepbound, go off it, and then regain almost all of it. Instead of going off totally, lower your dose from 2.5 mg to 2. If you don't gain any weight, go down to 1.5. Keep lowering by half a mg per week as long as you stay at or below your goal weight. If you go above your goal weight, even by a tenth of a pound, you stay at your current dose. If you gain more than three pounds above goal weight, go back up half a milligram. Done this way, you can taper all the way off over a couple of months and hold your new body the entire time. Walk down the stairs instead of jumping off the roof.

Not medical advice. Talk to your doctor.
close: Comment below to let me know if you've tried tapering off or if you're planning to.
